title: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. Each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate over successive edits, creating a gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor's original training and multi-turn inference. We introduce a training scheme that makes multi-turn image editing stable under this accumulating distribution shift. A key is to force the editor to operate on its own outputs from previous editing turns during training, bringing the principle of Self-Forcing to image editing. The main challenge is that self-generated editing trajectories deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision unreliable. translated_title: ACEdit：通过非对称条件实现稳定的多轮图像编辑
translated_abstract: 图像编辑模型在单次编辑中能产生令人印象深刻的结果，但在多轮编辑过程中质量往往会退化。每一轮编辑都会引入微小的分布偏移，这些偏移在连续编辑中不断累积，导致编辑器原始训练时遇到的输入分布与多轮推理时的输入分布之间产生差距。我们提出了一种训练方案，使多轮图像编辑在这种累积分布偏移下保持稳定。关键在于迫使编辑器在训练期间对其自身之前编辑轮次的输出进行操作，将“自我强制”原则引入图像编辑领域。主要挑战在于自生成的编辑轨迹会偏离真实轨迹，使得直接监督变得不可靠。我们通过一个蒸馏目标来解决这一挑战，该目标利用教师图像编辑器在模型对自身先前输出进行操作时提供可靠的训练信号。
tldr: 提出ACEdit训练方案，将自我强制原则引入图像编辑并借助教师编辑器的蒸馏目标提供可靠监督，从而解决多轮图像编辑中累积分布偏移导致的质量退化问题。
en_tdlr: ACEdit introduces a training scheme that brings the Self-Forcing principle to image editing and uses a distillation objective with a teacher editor to provide reliable supervision, stabilizing multi-turn image editing under accumulating distribution shifts.
